observation.command: echo "=== RabbitMQ ==="; rabbitmqctl status 2>/dev/null | grep -E "RabbitMQ version|Uptime" | head -3; rabbitmqctl list_queues name type durable 2>/dev/null | head -15; rabbitmqctl list_policies name definition 2>/dev/null | head -5; rabbitmqctl list_users 2>/dev/null; echo "=== MinIO ==="; curl -s -m 10 -o /dev/null -w "minio:%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:9000/minio/health/live; ls /opt/minio-data 2>/dev/null
